gapRegister.description: Risk of SafetyRegistry acting as a shadow engineering model or separate revision authority.
gapRegister.resolution: Bound SafetyRegistry strictly as a domain object state manager. Revision, configuration, verification, and Digital Thread authority are delegated entirely to SECP Core execution authority.

gapRegister.description: Potential for synthetic/AI agents to execute safety sign-offs or override unacceptable risk levels.
gapRegister.resolution: Implemented strict assertHumanSafetyAuthority check in SafetyGovernanceEngine rejecting any role or actor ID containing AI, synthetic, or agent keywords.

gapRegister.description: Lack of semantic propagation when underlying physical measurements (P10) or failure modes (P11) are mutated or invalidated.
gapRegister.resolution: Implemented handleEvidenceInvalidation() in SafetyGovernanceEngine, cascading status transitions to REASSESSMENT_REQUIRED across dependent controls, claims, and cases.

gapRegister.description: Risk of non-deterministic snapshot serialization or undetected payload tampering during rehydration.
gapRegister.resolution: Implemented SHA-256 Merkle root computation across ID-sorted domain arrays in SafetyPersistenceEngine, enforcing snapshot tamper detection upon rehydration.

gapRegister.description: Risk of creating a parallel safety thread or detached lineage graph.
gapRegister.resolution: Integrated all P12 nodes and edges directly into P4 DigitalThreadRegistry using standardized canonical edge types (CAUSES, MITIGATES, ADDRESSES, SUPPORTED_BY, CONTAINS).

futureRoadmapObservations.note: P12 provides the required clean safety truth foundation for upcoming P13+ advanced operational safety and physical execution phases.
